# Document

# **Salon Setup & Management Module**

## **Business Requirements Document (BRD) & Product Requirements Document (PRD)**

**Product Owner:** KP  
**Product:** Beauty Salon Appointment Booking SaaS Platform  
**Module:** Salon Setup & Management  
**Document Type:** BRD \+ PRD (Combined)  
**Audience:** Product, Engineering, QA, Design, Stakeholders

---

# **PART A — BUSINESS REQUIREMENTS DOCUMENT (BRD)**

## **1\. Business Background**

Beauty salons onboarding onto the platform must configure their business details, staff, services, and operating rules before accepting customer appointments. Without a structured setup process, booking accuracy, staff allocation, and customer experience degrade significantly.

This module ensures every tenant (salon) is **operationally ready** before entering the booking lifecycle.

---

## **2\. Business Objectives**

* Enable salon owners to self-onboard without manual support  
* Reduce time-to-first-booking  
* Ensure standardized and clean operational data  
* Support scalable multi-tenant growth

---

## **3\. Business Stakeholders**

| Stakeholder | Responsibility |
| ----- | ----- |
| Product Owner | Feature definition & prioritization |
| Salon Owner | Salon configuration & operations |
| Platform Admin | Tenant governance |
| Engineering Team | Implementation |
| Support Team | Assisted onboarding |

---

## **4\. In-Scope (Business)**

* Salon business profile  
* Staff onboarding & management  
* Service catalog management  
* Working hours & availability  
* Role-based access control (tenant-level)

## **5\. Out-of-Scope (Business – Phase 1\)**

* Multi-branch salons  
* Payroll & commissions  
* Loyalty programs  
* Inventory management

---

## **6\. Business Assumptions**

* Each tenant represents a single salon (Phase 1\)  
* At least one OWNER exists per salon  
* Services and staff must exist before appointments

---

## **7\. Business Risks & Mitigations**

| Risk | Mitigation |
| ----- | ----- |
| Incomplete setup | Enforced setup wizard |
| Incorrect working hours | Validation rules |
| Unauthorized access | RBAC enforcement |

---

# **PART B — PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS DOCUMENT (PRD)**

## **8\. User Personas**

### **8.1 Salon Owner**

* Business owner  
* Full control of salon setup

### **8.2 Salon Admin**

* Operational manager  
* Manages staff and services

### **8.3 Salon Staff**

* Service provider  
* Views assigned schedule

---

## **9\. Functional Requirements**

### **FR-SS-01: Salon Profile Management**

**Description:** Configure salon business details.

**Fields:**

* Salon name  
* Address  
* Contact details  
* Timezone  
* Logo  
* Currency

**Rules:**

* Editable only by OWNER  
* Timezone locked after first save

---

### **FR-SS-02: Staff Management**

**Description:** Manage salon employees.

**Capabilities:**

* Create staff users  
* Assign roles (ADMIN, STAFF)  
* Define working hours  
* Mark leave/unavailability  
* Activate/deactivate staff

**Rules:**

* OWNER creates ADMIN and STAFF  
* ADMIN creates STAFF only  
* STAFF cannot manage others

---

### **FR-SS-03: Service Management**

**Description:** Define bookable services.

**Fields:**

* Name  
* Category  
* Duration  
* Price  
* Assigned staff  
* Status

**Rules:**

* Duration must align with slot size  
* Inactive services cannot be booked

---

### **FR-SS-04: Working Hours & Availability**

**Description:** Configure operating hours.

**Configuration:**

* Business days  
* Opening/closing time  
* Break slots  
* Slot duration

**Rules:**

* Staff hours must fall within salon hours  
* Slot duration immutable once bookings exist

---

### **FR-SS-05: Role Assignment**

**Description:** Assign tenant-level roles.

**Roles:** OWNER, ADMIN, STAFF

**Rules:**

* OWNER role cannot be removed  
* Minimum one OWNER per tenant

---

## **10\. User Stories**

* As a Salon Owner, I want to set up my salon profile so customers see correct information  
* As a Salon Owner, I want to add staff before accepting bookings  
* As a Salon Admin, I want to configure services offered  
* As a Staff member, I want to view my availability

---

## **11\. Non-Functional Requirements**

* Tenant data isolation  
* Audit logging for OWNER actions  
* Concurrent-safe updates  
* \<300ms response time for setup APIs

---

## **12\. Dependencies**

* Tenant onboarding completed  
* Authentication & RBAC modules live  
* Package-feature mapping available

---

## **13\. Acceptance Criteria**

* Salon cannot accept bookings without setup completion  
* Only authorized roles can modify setup  
* Services and staff visible immediately after creation

---

## **14\. Success Metrics**

* Setup completion time \< 15 minutes  
* First booking within 24 hours of onboarding  
* \<5% setup abandonment rate

---

## **15\. Future Enhancements**

* Multi-branch support  
* Staff commission models  
* Advanced scheduling rules

# Database

# **Salon Setup & Management – Database Schema with Sample Data**

This document provides the **database schema and sample data** for the Salon Setup & Management module of the Beauty Salon Appointment Booking SaaS.

It aligns with the BRD/PRD and visual flows.

---

## **1\. Tables Overview**

* `tenants` – Salon information  
* `users` – All users including owners, admins, staff  
* `user_tenants` – Mapping of users to tenants  
* `roles` – Tenant-level roles  
* `user_roles` – Assign roles to users  
* `services` – Salon services offered  
* `staff_services` – Mapping staff to services  
* `working_hours` – Salon and staff schedules

---

## **2\. Tenants Table**

| Column | Type | Description |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| id | UUID | Primary key |
| name | VARCHAR | Salon name |
| address | VARCHAR | Salon address |
| contact\_number | VARCHAR | Salon contact |
| timezone | VARCHAR | Salon timezone |
| logo\_url | VARCHAR | Optional branding |
| package\_id | UUID | Subscription package |
| status | ENUM | ACTIVE, INACTIVE |
| created\_at | TIMESTAMP | Creation timestamp |

### **Sample Data**

| id | name | address | contact\_number | timezone | logo\_url | package\_id | status |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| t-101 | Salon X | 123 Main St | 9998887777 | Asia/Kolkata | logo1.png | p-002 | ACTIVE |

---

| Column | Type | Description |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |

| scope | ENUM | PLATFORM, TENANT, CONSUMER |

## **10\. Notes for Developers**

* Tenant-level isolation: staff, services, and working hours must always respect `tenant_id`.  
* Staff cannot be assigned services they are not mapped to.  
* Working hours at staff level cannot exceed salon-level hours.  
* Role-based access is enforced via `user_roles` and tenant RBAC.  
* This schema supports later multi-branch extension by adding `branch_id` in future.
